scope: Read-only review of current Java context integration and tests; Python implementation and end-to-end execution were not reviewed in this pass.
assessment: The context bridge runs for empty/source module and is invoked under the active worker permit before worker construction. Transport or checked-context failure prevents worker launch and finally releases the permit.

Request IDs are canonicalized, deduplicated, sorted and bounded before the bridge; the response requires the five fields, exact document/base and safe head, ten artifact keys and bounded encoding, and a requested-ID subset with one of eight kinds. Returned state is defensively copied.

The focused tests cover empty input, identity and shape failures, kinds, ID boundary, oversized artifact, and failed/interrupted context before worker construction. The private gateway independently checks the response nonce and envelope.

Artifact semantic validity remains the fresh worker responsibility. Runtime SQL isolation, full HTTP/recovery tests, formal-to-runtime correspondence and performance acceptance are separate obligations.
validation: No tests independently run during this review; focused Maven tests reported running by parent.
